# Tin

<!-- Generated by tools/theme-readme-gen.py from scheme.toml; do not edit. -->

Terminal-inspired colors for GNOME (GTK 3, GTK 4 and libadwaita, GNOME Shell) and for terminals and command-line tools. Variants: dark only.

![Tin dark palette](palette-dark.svg)

- Colors: Tin (colours of the Ptyxis built-in 'Tin'; origin named in the built-in's header: https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh/tree/master/themes/Tin.yml).
- Default accent: yellow (#888D4E); the other accents are listed by `switch-theme`.
- Ptyxis uses its built-in palette `Tin`.

## Install and use

```
ujust gnome-candy install-theme tin
ujust gnome-candy switch-theme tin
```

Without the image recipe, run `just install-theme tin` and `just switch-theme tin` in a checkout of [candy-for-gnome](https://github.com/redcodeworks/candy-for-gnome).

The generated GTK and Shell files in `gtk/` derive from the stock GTK and GNOME Shell stylesheets and stay under the LGPL (each folder there has its `LICENSE`). The tooling and this page are MIT; the color credits are in the repository `NOTICE`.
